Implemented the Rust port as a Cargo project in `/output` with the required root entry file [test11.rs](/output/test11.rs:1) and modular library code in [src/lib.rs](/output/src/lib.rs:1), [src/cli.rs](/output/src/cli.rs:1), [src/program.rs](/output/src/program.rs:1), and [src/vector.rs](/output/src/vector.rs:1).
